source_evidence: Exact player 'yes' accepts Cirren's proposed cautious bracing and clearing of deliberately packed rubble. D338~06:24–06:49, Fenar selects sound spare mining timber/offcuts and wedges from the existing abandoned worksite (new mundane physical detail), not the two installed gallery props; Cirren checks placement according to the prior successful Investigation23 and casts Guidance on Fenar. V provides routine feasible Help by steadying pieces while Fenar positions the brace; no new limited feature or personal equipment spent. Predetermined Athletics DC13 for controlled bracing/removal; on failure stop with original supporting stones intact. Actual visible Python secrets batch d2a1dff42a44140ae7898bdbaf6b3f22: advantage d20 faces8,7 keep8 +8 Athletics + Guidance d4=4 =20/DC13 success. Brace seated against fractured lip, loose upper packing removed in controlled sequence, existing supporting wedges and installed props left in place; creates a roughly 3ft-wide, 4ft-high accessible opening without collapse or damage. Local temporary brace supports the cleared lip, not a professional mine-wide safety certification. Cleared stones set aside, not taken; spare timber/wedges now installed, no personal cost or asset claim. New visible geometry beyond cleared packing: about10ft gently descending natural throat leads to a narrow rock shelf overlooking a natural cavern; from the opening/approach Cirren's Light reveals the nearby shelf and portions of cavern wall, with a roughly30ft drop below the shelf and a continuing metallic-looking seam exposed on the near wall. Distant dripping/running water and cool airflow, no sound of voices or creatures, no worked steps or fresh extraction beyond this point visible, no established safe descent, no verified deeper route, new foe, hoard, magical effect, ancient connection or reason for sealing proven. The opening and near view are discovered without traversing the exposed shelf or descending the drop; those consequential choices remain pending. Mineral identity, amount, purity, value and legal ownership unverified. Detect Magic already expired, Light on shield until~07:10, Guidance consumed by check. All previous unclaimed loot and ore remain on site. No new damage, spell slot, MP, supplies consumed, other limited feature, expenditure, rest or travel progress.
